spec_text_vs_execution_drift.drift_observed: Despite BA's awareness, the MEASURABLE clauses in AC2-AC8 are written in runtime-execution form, not static-inspection form. Concretely: AC3 says 'docker ps --format ... shows the same CreatedAt' (runtime); AC5 says 'grep TASK-ID /var/log/happy-restart.log returns ≥1 hit per invocation' (post-runtime log artifact); AC6 says 'tail /var/log/happy-session-recovery.log shows Scoped save' (runtime); AC7 says 'a fake-corrupted state.json causes --target dev to log the ERROR' (runtime); AC8 says 'echo $? prints 2' (runtime).
spec_text_vs_execution_drift.consequence: Dev subagent will land the implementation but cannot self-verify these 7 ACs because the hook permanently blocks the subagent from running happy-restart.sh. QA subagent verifying after dev will face the same hook block. The static-inspection equivalent of each MEASURABLE clause exists (e.g. AC3 static form: 'grep -c "docker compose up" outside the all-prod/all/jade/default/qijie target branches = 0'; AC5 static form: 'grep -E "TASK-ID:\s*c1-20260504-223115" /root/bin/happy-restart.sh returns ≥1 line in the script'; AC8 static form: 'grep -E "exit\s+2" + grep "BLOCKED: unknown target" both present in script') but BA did not write them.
spec_text_vs_execution_drift.remediation_required: BA must add a 'STATIC-INSPECTION MEASURABLE' subclause to each of AC2, AC3, AC5, AC6, AC7, AC8 that is verifiable by reading the refactored script source alone (grep / structural patterns), distinct from the runtime MEASURABLE that the user exercises post-merge from a real TTY. AC1, AC4 already have grep-friendly measurables.
spec_text_vs_execution_drift.rationale_severity: Dev can still land the refactor against the GIVEN/WHEN/THEN logic; the runtime-MEASURABLE doesn't gate the implementation. But QA's eventual close-cycle on this concern WILL be blocked by inability to run any of AC2-AC8's measurables, so the AC text needs a static parallel before close. If BA fixes this BEFORE dev starts (cheap, just text addition), QA close path is unblocked downstream. If BA does not fix, QA close-cycle will return PASS_AS_SUBSTITUTE for AC2/3/5/6/7/8 verifications based on static-inspection-equivalents, which is a known anti-pattern in this codebase per spec-20260503-091826 §5.4 rule 4.
